adjudication.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController#add_members and #remove_member, membership changes are applied via association mutations (group.add(user) and group.users.delete(user_id)) before checking group.save for success. In Rails, deleting/adding through associations typically persists immediately to the join table, while group.save only validates/saves the Group record. If group.save fails (e.g., due to validations/callbacks on Group), the controller returns a 422 even though the membership change already took effect, leaving the client with an error response for a successful mutation. This risk is directly visible in the diff: the mutation happens before the conditional on group.save in both actions.
